# IMPERIA COLD WAR — France 1970 political and party programmes.
# Generated by tools/france_1970/compile.py from the approved revision 4.

on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			FRA = { COLDWAR_FRA_1970_initialize = yes }
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_FRA_is_1970 = yes }
				COLDWAR_FRA_1970_initialize = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_government_epoch = 1 } FRA = { COLDWAR_FRA_offer_maintenance = yes } }
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_FRA_is_1970 = yes } COLDWAR_FRA_refresh_programmes = yes }
		}
	}
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_government_epoch = 1 } FRA = { COLDWAR_FRA_offer_maintenance = yes } }
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_FRA_is_1970 = yes } COLDWAR_FRA_refresh_programmes = yes }
		}
	}
}
